videoDetails.title: Three Questions Series with Denine Blevins of Parakaleo
videoDetails.shortDescription:
In this episode of the Three Question Series from the Alliance for Mission and Renewal, Christine Gordon talks with Denine Blevins, Executive Director of Parakaleo, about caring well for the women who serve in church-planting contexts.

Denine shares practical wisdom and heartfelt encouragement for pastors, planters, and leaders who want to build healthier, more sustainable ministries—ones that nurture the spiritual and emotional wellbeing of everyone involved.
